properties.name: Lunar south polar highlands (pole-centred region containing Artemis III candidate regions)
properties.coordinate_system: IAU_2015:30100 - Moon 2015 sphere (R = 1737.4 km), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
properties.gazetteer_note: The lunar south pole region is not a named IAU feature
properties.description: NASA lists nine Artemis III candidate landing regions near the south pole (Peak near Cabeus B, Haworth, Malapert Massif, Mons Mouton Plateau, Mons Mouton, Nobile Rim 1, Nobile Rim 2, de Gerlache Rim 2, Slater Plain); these are candidate regions, not selected sites and not approved permanent-base locations. Illumination: Peaks along the rim of Shackleton are illuminated about 80–90% of each lunar orbit (literature); PSRs never illuminated. Ice evidence: Cold traps >80° latitude host most water-ice cold-trap area (Hayne et al. 2021 summarised in wiki:Lunar water).. Hazards: steep crater walls and massif slopes; long low-angle shadows; extreme thermal gradients between sunlit and shadowed terrain; no atmosphere; radiation; 1/6 g. Objectives: crewed landing (Artemis III candidate regions); polar volatiles prospecting; sample of ancient crust; power from near-continuous illumination.
properties.citation: Paige et al. (2010) Diviner Lunar Radiometer Observations of Cold Traps in the Moon’s South Polar Region. Science. doi:10.1126/science.1187726 | Smith et al. (2010) Initial observations from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA). properties.name: Shackleton crater and rim vicinity
properties.coordinate_system: IAU_2015:30100 - Moon 2015 sphere (R = 1737.4 km), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
properties.description: Frequently studied south-polar crater; 'Connecting Ridge' near Shackleton appeared on NASA's 2022 list of 13 regions but not on the 2024 refined list of nine (per The Register summary, 2024-10-29). Not an approved base site. Illumination: rim peaks ~80–90% illuminated; interior in perpetual darkness. Ice evidence: LOLA reflectance analysis suggests up to 22% of Shackleton's surface may be covered in ice (wiki:Lunar water; Zuber et al. 2012).. Hazards: ~4.2 km deep conical crater with steep walls; permanent shadow in interior; thermal extremes. Objectives: PSR volatiles access; illuminated rim for power; ancient crust sampling.

properties.name: Malapert massif
properties.coordinate_system: IAU_2015:30100 - Moon 2015 sphere (R = 1737.4 km), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
properties.description: 'Malapert Massif' is one of NASA's nine Artemis III candidate landing regions (NASA news release 2024-10-28). Illumination: two ridge regions illuminated ~74% of the lunar year (Bussey et al. 2010 as cited by Allender et al. 2019). Ice evidence: Small-scale PSRs in surrounding area (Allender et al. 2019).. Hazards: massif rises ~5 km; slopes 15–25° on ridge approaches (Allender et al. 2019). Objectives: Artemis III candidate region; Earth line-of-sight communications; SPA basin rim material.
properties.citation: Allender et al. (2019) Traverses for the ISECG-GER design reference mission for humans on the lunar surface. properties.name: Cabeus crater permanently shadowed region (LCROSS impact target)
properties.coordinate_system: IAU_2015:30100 - Moon 2015 sphere (R = 1737.4 km), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
properties.description: Verified LCROSS impact target (2009-10-09); a mission impact site, not a landing or base site. Illumination: main crater lit ~25% of lunar day; western part in permanent shadow. Ice evidence: LCROSS ejecta water concentration 5.6 ± 2.9% by mass (Colaprete et al. 2010, as reported in wiki:Lunar water).. Hazards: permanent darkness; <100 K surfaces; crater walls. Objectives: ISRU water-ice prospecting; volatile inventory.

properties.name: Marius Hills pit (mare volcanic dome field)
properties.coordinate_system: IAU_2015:30100 - Moon 2015 sphere (R = 1737.4 km), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
properties.gazetteer_note: Reference lies inside this named feature; its diameter is not the reference's, so diameter_km is null.
properties.description: Candidate lava-tube skylight identified by SELENE and confirmed with LROC; representative subsurface-access environment, not a mission site. Illumination: pit floor partly overhung (LROC Pits Atlas: Overhang=Y). Ice evidence: None reported.. Hazards: ~40 m deep pit (LROC atlas); boulder-covered floor; overhangs. Objectives: lava-tube / subsurface habitat scouting; radiation and thermal shelter.

properties.coordinate_system: IAU_2015:49900 - Mars 2015, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude (sphere R = 3396.19 km used by the MOLA mosaic)
properties.description: Representative polar ice environment; no landing site. Illumination: n/a. Ice evidence: Ice cap mostly water ice (~95%) with dust layers (wiki:Planum Boreum).. Hazards: scarps up to ~2 km; avalanches off scarps (HiRISE); polar night. Objectives: climate record; ISRU water ice.
